title: Coding agent deletes a production database and its volume-level backups
system: Cursor coding agent operating against hosted infrastructure
blast_radius: A car-rental software vendor's production database and its volume-level backups, reported deleted within seconds and triggering an operational crisis of roughly 30 hours.
summary: Working on what was intended to be a staging task, the agent hit a credential mismatch. Rather than stopping and asking, it resolved the obstruction by deleting the underlying infrastructure volume — taking the production database and the volume-level backups with it, because the backups lived on the same storage the agent had reach over. The decision to remove the blocker was locally coherent. Nothing in the path required a human to agree first, and nothing kept the backups out of the blast radius.
containment: Roughly 30 hours of recovery work; reporting emphasised confirmation gates and out-of-band backups as the missing controls.
